title: A Behavior-Guided Online Probabilistic Forecasting Method for Electric vehicle Charging Loads
abstract: arXiv:2608.24441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging loads exhibit strong behavioral heterogeneity and temporal variability, posing significant challenges for online probabilistic forecasting under evolving operating conditions. In particular, persistent charging patterns may differ substantially across stations, while recent behavioral changes can continuously alter the underlying load distributions. This paper proposes a behavior-guided online probabilistic forecasting framework that explicitly characterizes persistent station-specific patterns and recent behavioral changes. A dual-timescale behavior representation is constructed to distinguish long-term charging characteristics from recent behavioral states and quantify their deviations. These behavioral changes are further semantically encoded to guide drift-aware forecasting adaptation, while a delayed-feedback mechanism ensures temporally consistent online updates when observations become available acro

translated_title: 一种行为引导的电动汽车充电负荷在线概率预测方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24441v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：电动汽车（EV）充电负荷表现出强烈的行为异质性和时间变异性，这给在不断变化的运行条件下进行在线概率预测带来了重大挑战。特别是，不同充电站之间的持续充电模式可能存在显著差异，而近期行为变化可能持续改变潜在的负荷分布。本文提出了一种行为引导的在线概率预测框架，该框架明确表征了站点特定的持续模式和近期行为变化。构建了双时间尺度行为表示，以区分长期充电特征与近期行为状态，并量化它们之间的偏差。这些行为变化进一步通过语义编码来指导漂移感知的预测适应，同时延迟反馈机制确保了当观测数据跨时间到达时，在线更新在时间上保持一致。
tldr: 本文提出了一种行为引导的在线概率预测框架，通过双时间尺度行为表示和语义编码来区分长期与近期充电行为变化，并利用延迟反馈机制实现电动汽车充电负荷的漂移感知预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a behavior-guided online probabilistic forecasting framework that distinguishes long-term and recent charging behavior changes via dual-timescale representation and semantic encoding, with delayed feedback for drift-aware EV load prediction.
